notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 (Zoom's fiscal 2026; data.js fy 'Jan 2026'). Sources: FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001585521-26-000030) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001628280-26-028866), read on EDGAR. LEADER: Eric Yuan is founder, President and CEO. The proxy gives his class percentages and 37.7% of total voting power but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the economic share is in leader.derived (7.11%); the 10-K separately says Yuan and his affiliates held approximately 7.1% of outstanding capital stock at January 31, 2026. His Class B shares are held by the 2018 Yuan and Zhang Revocable Trust, of which he and his spouse are cotrustees; his Class A figure is RSUs settling within 60 days. HOLDERS: the proxy gives the other large holders only as a percentage of one class, so they are recorded with basis 'class' and never used to compute everyone else: Vanguard 10.2% and BlackRock 6.6% of Class A (BlackRock's from a 13G/A reporting holdings at December 31, 2024, so stale), and Emergence Capital Partners 10.2% of Class B (held of record at the proxy date; director Santiago Subotovsky shares control of it). Buybacks include excise taxes, as the cash-flow line says. Rounded geography segments sum to 4.87.
